MindFlow needs access to your heart rate and activity data to detect stress levels and provide personalized meditation recommendations. This helps us understand when you might benefit most from a mindfulness session.
MindFlow would like to save your meditation sessions to the Health app so you can track your mindfulness practice alongside other health metrics.
MindFlow needs access to your calendar to identify important events and meetings that might cause stress. This allows us to proactively suggest meditation sessions before high-stress situations.
MindFlow can use your microphone to create a personalized instructor voice for your meditation sessions. This is completely optional and you can skip this feature.
MindFlow sends you timely notifications when stress is detected or to remind you about your meditation practice. These notifications help you maintain a consistent mindfulness routine.
